meta.name: prisma-database-setup
meta.description: Guides for configuring Prisma with different database providers (PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQLite, MongoDB, etc.). Use when setting up a new project, changing databases, or troubleshooting connection issues. Triggers on "configure postgres", "connect to mysql", "setup mongodb", "sqlite setup".

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果在项目初期需要配置Prisma连接数据库
copy.tagline_en: Configure Prisma to connect to various databases
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure Prisma for your project's database connection

howto.what: Claude 会按数据库种类帮你配置 Prisma,包括选择数据库类型、安装驱动适配器、生成客户端,并处理连接字符串等问题。
howto.when: 当你开启新项目、更换数据库或排查连接问题时触发;也会在你提到“配置 postgres”“连接 mysql”“设置 mongodb”等说法时激活。

say.text: 帮我用 PostgreSQL 配置新的 Prisma 项目
say.note: 会给出 schema、适配器和客户端生成步骤

say.text: 我想把数据库从 SQLite 换成 MySQL
say.note: 会指导修改 provider 及对应适配器

say.text: 我的 Prisma 连不上数据库,帮我排查
say.note: 会检查连接字符串和环境变量

howto.what_en: Claude will guide you through configuring Prisma for your database: choosing the provider, installing the matching driver adapter, generating the client, and resolving connection settings.
howto.when_en: Triggers when starting a new project, switching databases, or troubleshooting connection issues. Also activates on phrases like "configure postgres", "connect to mysql", "setup mongodb", etc.

say_en.text: Help me set up a new Prisma project with PostgreSQL.
say_en.note: You'll get schema, adapter, and client generation steps.

say_en.text: I want to switch my database from SQLite to MySQL.
say_en.note: You'll be guided on provider and adapter changes.

say_en.text: My Prisma can't connect to the database; troubleshoot it.
say_en.note: It will check connection strings and environment variables.
